generate_clangd_config: generate a .clangd configuration file for sglang JIT kernel development with default CUDA architecture
generate_clangd_with_dependencies: generate a .clangd file including extra dependency library include paths via --dependencies flag
generate_clangd_cuda_target: generate a .clangd file targeting a specific CUDA architecture using --cuda-target flag
overwrite_clangd_config: overwrite an existing .clangd file by passing the --overwrite flag to generate_clangd
generate_clangd_default_flags: generate a .clangd file with default compile flags including -xcuda, -Wall, -Wextra, and system include paths
